newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W Manila unit posts 429.2 mln net in 1996.
newsitem.headline: C&W Manila unit posts 429.2 mln net in 1996.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI), an affiliate of Cable & Wireless Inc, said on Friday the company posted 429.2 million pesos in net income in 1996, up 29.4 percent from 331.6 million in the previous year.
ETPI president Melquiades Gutierrez said in a statement that the firm logged 1.34 billion pesos in revenues last year from 1.12 billion pesos in 1995.
The official said the net income last year was 43 percent higher than the target.
Income from operations was at 511 million pesos last year compared with 416.2 million in 1995.
ETPI is an international gateway facility operator and provides data communications service, international private leased circuits and international telex.
Sixty percent of the company's shares have been sequestered by the Philippine government on suspicions they belonged to business associates of deposed President Ferdinand Marcos.
The government has been trying to recover wealth allegedly stolen by Marcos during his years in power. The Marcos family has denied the charge.
Under a compromise agreement with one of the Marcos associates in 1990, the government now holds 50.2 percent while Cable & Wireless has 40 percent.
Smart Communications Co Inc, a unit of Metro Pacific Corp, last year bought 9.8 percent stake in the company.
